title: lemmaphyllum microphyllum var. nobukoanum

This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its therapeutic actions.
